inputs.text: Concerns are mounting over proposed changes to Cyprus’ surveillance legislation, particularly efforts to remove judicial oversight as a key safeguard, lawyers said on Monday. The amended bill is expected to be brought before the House plenum for a vote on Thursday. According to Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides, following a recent closed session of the House [...]
